author: Jazziner
body:
For insults/harassments in game (offensive area names...), contact Odie at hello@playorna.com

You can also hide others players buildings, hide or change your character name... 

For anything not related to in-game actions (like phone harassment), admins can't help. You can contact local authorities, change your phone number, block anonymous calls...

As a former ingress player, I know toxics players can find many ways to ruin your life. Unfortunately, the "best" way to deal with this kind of people seems to ignore them, and never interact with them. With time, they grow tired of it...

body: From your comments it does not sound like this guy is going away anytime soon. I'm not an authority whatsoever in this area. author: tincmetals98
body:
Someone taking an area next to where you live is part of the game. It can also happen often. Sometime it can go back and forth a lot. I think your key is to not let anyone know you live there. People can't know unless you let them. 

Such worries is why there are options on your buildings to not make them public. Then in your character to not let your location be known. The latter removes your name from when you take territories. That way someone can't figure out where your frequent, directly.

If someone is going to take all the effort to rename characters to insult you and take some of your territories. Take a breather.... Now that you have. The truth is you shouldn't get upset. If you think about it, they are the ones upset. Either they are upset at your taking the territories back or they are wasting their time. Wasting time trying to provoke you. So let them waste it.

Now if he names one of his pets into a statement that is threatening. By all means, contact Odie.

I currently am playfully going back and forth with someone else. They should see it as fun competition and shouldn't think I'm stalking their home or work. Though they probably are playing at those places, where as I just pass by a few times a week.
